```mermaid
    SingleProc -->|Yes| SingleWorkerCycle[Enter Single Process Cycle<br/>ngx_single_process_cycle]
    
    SingleProc -->|No| BlockSignals[Block Process Signals<br/>SIGCHLD, SIGHUP, etc.]
    
    BlockSignals --> SpawnWorkers[Spawn Worker Processes<br/>ngx_start_worker_processes<br/>Count from worker_processes directive]
    
    SpawnWorkers --> SpawnCacheLoader[Spawn Cache Loader Process<br/>ngx_start_cache_manager_processes<br/>If proxy_cache_path configured]
    
    SpawnCacheLoader --> SpawnCacheManager[Spawn Cache Manager Process<br/>Periodic eviction and cleanup]
    
    SpawnCacheManager --> EnterMasterCycle[Enter Master Process Cycle<br/>ngx_master_process_cycle]
    
    EnterMasterCycle --> MasterLoop[Master Event Loop<br/>See Section 4.2.2]
    
    ExitError -.-> End([Process Termination])
    ExitSuccess -.-> End
    MasterLoop -.-> End
    SingleWorkerCycle -.-> End
```

**Key Implementation Details**:

- **Configuration Cycle** (`src/core/ngx_cycle.c`): The cycle structure contains all configuration, listening sockets, shared memory zones, and module contexts. Configuration reload creates a new cycle while preserving the old cycle until graceful transition completes.

- **Socket Inheritance**: Listening sockets bind with SO_REUSEADDR (and SO_REUSEPORT where supported) enabling graceful binary upgrades through socket inheritance via environment variables.

- **Shared Memory Zones**: Created via mmap (Unix) or CreateFileMapping (Windows) with slab allocator for efficient allocation. Zone names must be unique across cache zones, limit zones, and upstream zones.

- **Worker Process Count**: The `worker_processes` directive supports numeric values or `auto` (matching CPU core count via sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN) on Unix).

### 4.2.2 Master Process Event Loop

The master process supervises worker processes through signal-driven event handling, responding to operational commands and child process state changes.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Master Cycle Entry]) --> SetTitle[Set Process Title<br/>setproctitle: master process]
    
    SetTitle --> InitSignalSet[Initialize Signal Set<br/>Block signals for sigsuspend]
    
    InitSignalSet --> MainLoop{Master Event Loop}
    
    MainLoop --> SigSuspend[Wait for Signals<br/>sigsuspend - Atomic unblock & wait]
    
    SigSuspend --> SignalReceived{Signal Received?}
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGCHLD<br/>ngx_reap| ReapChildren[Reap Child Processes<br/>ngx_reap_children<br/>waitpid WNOHANG]
    
    ReapChildren --> CheckRespawn{Need Respawn?}
    CheckRespawn -->|Worker Died| RespawnWorker[Respawn Worker Process]
    CheckRespawn -->|Cache Died| RespawnCache[Respawn Cache Process]
    CheckRespawn -->|Normal Exit| MainLoop
    RespawnWorker --> MainLoop
    RespawnCache --> MainLoop
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGHUP<br/>ngx_reconfigure| Reconfigure[Configuration Reload<br/>See Section 4.2.4]
    Reconfigure --> MainLoop
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGTERM<br/>ngx_terminate| TerminateWorkers[Send SIGTERM to Workers<br/>Immediate shutdown]
    TerminateWorkers --> WaitTerminate[Wait for Workers to Exit<br/>Non-graceful]
    WaitTerminate --> Cleanup[Clean Up Resources]
    Cleanup --> Exit([Master Exit])
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGQUIT<br/>ngx_quit| QuitWorkers[Send SIGQUIT to Workers<br/>Graceful shutdown]
    QuitWorkers --> WaitGraceful[Wait for Workers to Drain<br/>Complete existing requests]
    WaitGraceful --> Cleanup
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGUSR1<br/>ngx_reopen| ReopenLogs[Send SIGUSR1 to Workers<br/>Reopen log files]
    ReopenLogs --> ReopenMaster[Reopen Master Log Files]
    ReopenMaster --> MainLoop
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGUSR2<br/>ngx_change_binary| BinaryUpgrade[Binary Upgrade Sequence<br/>See Section 4.2.5]
    BinaryUpgrade --> MainLoop
    
    SignalReceived -->|SIGWINCH<br/>ngx_noaccept| NoAccept[Send SIGWINCH to Workers<br/>Stop accepting connections]
    NoAccept --> MainLoop
    
    SignalReceived -->|No Signal| CheckDelay[Check Delay Timers<br/>worker start delay]
    CheckDelay --> MainLoop
```

**Signal Handling Details**:

- **Signal Safety**: Master process blocks signals during normal operation, atomically unblocking only during sigsuspend. Signal handlers set global flags (ngx_reap, ngx_quit, etc.) examined after sigsuspend returns.

- **Child Reaping**: SIGCHLD triggers waitpid with WNOHANG to collect exit status of terminated children. Master respawns crashed workers while respecting shutdown flags.

- **Graceful Shutdown**: SIGQUIT initiates graceful shutdown where workers stop accepting new connections, complete in-flight requests, and exit cleanly. Master waits with timeout before forcing termination.

### 4.2.3 Worker Process Initialization

Worker processes initialize their event-driven infrastructure and enter the main processing loop.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Worker Process Forked]) --> InitWorker[Worker Initialization<br/>ngx_worker_process_init]
    
    InitWorker --> SetEnv[Set Environment Variables]
    
    SetEnv --> SetPriority{Priority Configured?<br/>worker_priority}
    SetPriority -->|Yes| SetNice[Set Process Priority<br/>setpriority]
    SetPriority -->|No| SetRlimit
    SetNice --> SetRlimit{Resource Limits?<br/>worker_rlimit_*}
    
    SetRlimit -->|Yes| ApplyRlimit[Apply rlimit Values<br/>setrlimit: NOFILE, CORE, etc.]
    SetRlimit -->|No| SetUser
    ApplyRlimit --> SetUser{User/Group Configured?<br/>user directive}
    
    SetUser -->|Yes| DropPrivileges[Drop Privileges<br/>setgid, setuid<br/>Initialize supplementary groups]
    SetUser -->|No| SetAffinity
    DropPrivileges --> SetAffinity{CPU Affinity?<br/>worker_cpu_affinity}
    
    SetAffinity -->|Yes| BindCPU[Bind to CPU Cores<br/>sched_setaffinity Linux<br/>cpuset_setaffinity FreeBSD]
    SetAffinity -->|No| UnblockSignals
    BindCPU --> UnblockSignals[Unblock Signals<br/>Clear signal mask]
    
    UnblockSignals --> CloseUnusedChannels[Close Unused IPC Channels<br/>Close other workers' channels]
    
    CloseUnusedChannels --> RegisterChannel[Register Channel Event<br/>ngx_channel_handler<br/>Receives commands from master]
    
    RegisterChannel --> InitModules[Call Module Init Hooks<br/>Worker init for each module]
    
    InitModules --> InitConnectionPool[Initialize Connection Pool<br/>worker_connections connections<br/>Read/Write event structures]
    
    InitConnectionPool --> InitAcceptMutex{Accept Mutex Needed?<br/>Multiple workers, no SO_REUSEPORT}
    InitAcceptMutex -->|Yes| SetupMutex[Setup Accept Mutex<br/>Shared memory or file-based]
    InitAcceptMutex -->|No| AddListenEvents
    SetupMutex --> AddListenEvents[Add Listening Events<br/>Accept handlers for listening sockets]
    
    AddListenEvents --> InitTimers[Initialize Timer RBTree<br/>Empty red-black tree]
    
    InitTimers --> EnterEventLoop[Enter Event Processing Loop<br/>ngx_process_events_and_timers<br/>See Section 4.3.1]
    
    EnterEventLoop --> EventLoop[Worker Event Loop<br/>Never returns unless shutdown]
    
    EventLoop --> ShutdownSignal{Shutdown Signal?<br/>SIGQUIT, SIGTERM, SIGINT}
    
    ShutdownSignal -->|SIGQUIT<br/>Graceful| CloseListening[Close Listening Sockets<br/>Stop accepting new connections]
    
    CloseListening --> DrainConnections[Drain Existing Connections<br/>Wait for completion]
    
    DrainConnections --> CheckActive{Active Connections?}
    CheckActive -->|Yes| WaitTimeout{Shutdown Timeout?<br/>worker_shutdown_timeout}
    WaitTimeout -->|Not Expired| DrainConnections
    WaitTimeout -->|Expired| ForceClose[Force Close Connections]
    CheckActive -->|No| CleanupWorker
    ForceClose --> CleanupWorker[Worker Cleanup<br/>Destroy pools, close files]
    
    ShutdownSignal -->|SIGTERM<br/>Immediate| ForceClose
    
    CleanupWorker --> Exit([Worker Process Exit])
```

**Worker Initialization Details**:

- **Privilege Dropping**: Workers drop privileges after binding sockets (master binds as root for ports <1024). The `user` directive specifies unprivileged user/group.

- **CPU Affinity**: Binds workers to specific CPU cores reducing cache thrashing. Configuration pattern: `worker_cpu_affinity 0001 0010 0100 1000;` for 4 workers on 4 cores.

- **Connection Pool**: Pre-allocates ngx_connection_t structures equal to worker_connections (default 1024). Each connection has associated read and write ngx_event_t structures.

- **Accept Mutex**: Serializes accept across workers when SO_REUSEPORT unavailable. Workers compete for mutex before accepting, preventing thundering herd. With SO_REUSEPORT, kernel distributes accepts directly.

### 4.2.4 Configuration Reload Sequence

Zero-downtime configuration reload through cycle transition enables runtime configuration changes.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([SIGHUP Received]) --> MasterReconfigure[Master: ngx_reconfigure Flag Set]
    
    MasterReconfigure --> SaveOldCycle[Save Pointer to Old Cycle]
    
    SaveOldCycle --> InitNewCycle[Initialize New Cycle<br/>ngx_init_cycle with old cycle]
    
    InitNewCycle --> ParseNewConfig[Parse New Configuration Files<br/>Read from disk]
    
    ParseNewConfig --> ParseFailed{Parse Errors?}
    ParseFailed -->|Yes| LogError[Log Error<br/>Configuration invalid]
    LogError --> RevertOld[Keep Old Cycle Active<br/>Continue with old configuration]
    RevertOld --> ReloadFailed([Reload Failed - Old Config Active])
    
    ParseFailed -->|No| OpenNewSockets[Open New Listening Sockets<br/>Bind changed addresses]
    
    OpenNewSockets --> BindFailed{Bind Errors?}
    BindFailed -->|Yes| LogError
    
    BindFailed -->|No| InitNewSharedMem[Initialize New Shared Memory<br/>Zones with new sizes/names]
    
    InitNewSharedMem --> InheritSockets[Inherit Unchanged Sockets<br/>Copy from old cycle]
    
    InheritSockets --> StartNewModules[Start New Modules<br/>Module init callbacks]
    
    StartNewModules --> SpawnNewWorkers[Spawn New Worker Processes<br/>New workers use new cycle]
    
    SpawnNewWorkers --> SendQuitOld[Send SIGQUIT to Old Workers<br/>Graceful shutdown signal]
    
    SendQuitOld --> OldWorkersDrain[Old Workers Drain Connections<br/>Complete in-flight requests]
    
    OldWorkersDrain --> MonitorOld{Old Workers Exited?}
    MonitorOld -->|Some Running| CheckTimeout{Reload Timeout?}
    CheckTimeout -->|Not Expired| OldWorkersDrain
    CheckTimeout -->|Expired| ForceKillOld[Send SIGKILL to Old Workers<br/>Force termination]
    ForceKillOld --> CloseOldSockets
    
    MonitorOld -->|All Exited| CloseOldSockets[Close Old Listening Sockets<br/>Release bound ports from old cycle]
    
    CloseOldSockets --> FreeOldSharedMem[Free Old Shared Memory<br/>Unmap old zones]
    
    FreeOldSharedMem --> DestroyOldCycle[Destroy Old Cycle<br/>Free old configuration memory]
    
    DestroyOldCycle --> ReloadComplete([Reload Complete - New Config Active])
    
    subgraph "Concurrent State"
        NewWorkers[New Workers<br/>Processing new requests<br/>New configuration]
        OldWorkers[Old Workers<br/>Draining connections<br/>Old configuration]
        NewWorkers -.->|Coexist| OldWorkers
    end
```

**Configuration Reload Details**:

- **Socket Reuse**: Unchanged listening sockets inherit from old cycle avoiding bind errors and connection loss.

- **Shared Memory Transition**: New shared memory zones initialize independently. Cache data does not transfer between reloads (cache cold-starts).

- **Worker Coexistence**: New and old workers coexist during transition. New workers accept connections using new configuration; old workers drain existing connections using old configuration.

- **Rollback Safety**: Configuration validation occurs before spawning new workers. Parse errors preserve old configuration without service disruption.

- **Module State**: Modules must handle initialization and cleanup properly supporting multiple active cycles during reload.

### 4.2.5 Binary Upgrade Sequence

Graceful binary replacement enables runtime upgrades without connection loss.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([SIGUSR2 Received]) --> MasterUpgrade[Master: ngx_change_binary Flag Set]
    
    MasterUpgrade --> SaveSocketEnv[Save Listening Sockets in Environment<br/>NGINX environment variable]
    
    SaveSocketEnv --> ForkExec[Fork and Execute New Binary<br/>ngx_exec_new_binary<br/>execve with preserved sockets]
    
    ForkExec --> ExecFailed{Exec Failed?}
    ExecFailed -->|Yes| LogExecError[Log Exec Error]
    LogExecError --> UpgradeFailed([Upgrade Failed - Old Binary Active])
    
    ExecFailed -->|No| NewMasterStarts[New Binary Starts as Master<br/>Inherits listening sockets]
    
    NewMasterStarts --> NewMasterInit[New Master Initializes<br/>Parses configuration]
    
    NewMasterInit --> NewInitFailed{New Init Failed?}
    NewInitFailed -->|Yes| NewMasterExits[New Master Exits]
    NewMasterExits --> OldMasterContinues[Old Master Continues Normally]
    OldMasterContinues --> UpgradeFailed
    
    NewInitFailed -->|No| NewSpawnWorkers[New Master Spawns New Workers<br/>With new binary]
    
    NewSpawnWorkers --> OldMasterWaits[Old Master Detects New Master<br/>via pidfile or signal]
    
    OldMasterWaits --> AdminDecision{Administrator Decision<br/>Monitor new version}
    
    AdminDecision -->|New Version OK| SendQuitToOld[Send SIGQUIT to Old Master<br/>Graceful shutdown]
    
    SendQuitToOld --> OldMasterShutdown[Old Master Sends SIGQUIT to Old Workers]
    
    OldMasterShutdown --> OldWorkersDrain[Old Workers Drain Connections]
    
    OldWorkersDrain --> OldWorkersExit[Old Workers Exit<br/>After completing requests]
    
    OldWorkersExit --> OldMasterExit[Old Master Cleans Up and Exits]
    
    OldMasterExit --> UpgradeComplete([Binary Upgrade Complete])
    
    AdminDecision -->|New Version Issues| SendHUPToOld[Send SIGHUP to Old Master<br/>Rollback to old binary]
    
    SendHUPToOld --> OldRespawnWorkers[Old Master Respawns Old Workers<br/>Resume accepting connections]
    
    OldRespawnWorkers --> SendTermToNew[Send SIGTERM to New Master<br/>Terminate new binary]
    
    SendTermToNew --> NewMasterKills[New Master Kills New Workers]
    
    NewMasterKills --> NewMasterExits2[New Master Exits]
    
    NewMasterExits2 --> RollbackComplete([Rollback Complete - Old Binary Active])
    
    subgraph "Coexistence Period"
        OldMaster[Old Master + Old Workers<br/>Old binary]
        NewMaster[New Master + New Workers<br/>New binary]
        SharedSockets[Shared Listening Sockets<br/>Both accept connections]
        OldMaster -.->|Share| SharedSockets
        NewMaster -.->|Share| SharedSockets
    end
```

**Binary Upgrade Details**:

- **Socket Preservation**: Listening socket file descriptors pass to new binary via environment variable NGINX. New binary recognizes inherited sockets and skips bind.

- **Dual Master Period**: Old and new master processes coexist. Both accept connections on shared sockets (SO_REUSEADDR). Kernel distributes accepts between old and new workers.

- **Testing Window**: Administrators monitor new binary behavior (error logs, metrics) before committing to upgrade. Rollback possible by restarting old master.

- **Graceful Transition**: Old workers continue serving existing connections. New connections route to new workers. System remains fully available throughout upgrade.

- **PID File Handling**: New master writes PID to `.oldbin` suffixed file. Old master retains original PID file. On old master exit, new master removes `.oldbin` file.

## 4.3 Event Processing Flows

### 4.3.1 Core Event Loop Processing

The event loop constitutes the heart of NGINX's non-blocking architecture, processing I/O events, timers, and posted events.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Event Loop Iteration]) --> ComputeNextTimer[Compute Next Timer Expiration<br/>Min value from timer RBTree]
    
    ComputeNextTimer --> CheckPosted{Posted Next Events?<br/>ngx_posted_next_events queue}
    CheckPosted -->|Yes| SetTimerZero[Set Timer to 0<br/>Process posted immediately]
    CheckPosted -->|No| CheckAcceptMutex
    SetTimerZero --> CheckAcceptMutex{Accept Mutex Enabled?<br/>!SO_REUSEPORT && multiple workers}
    
    CheckAcceptMutex -->|Yes| CheckDisabled{Accept Disabled?<br/>accept_disabled > 0}
    CheckDisabled -->|Yes| SkipMutex[Skip Mutex Acquisition<br/>Connection pool near limit]
    CheckDisabled -->|No| TryAcquireMutex{Try Acquire Mutex<br/>Non-blocking}
    
    TryAcquireMutex -->|Success| SetPostFlag[Set NGX_POST_EVENTS Flag<br/>Delay accept processing]
    TryAcquireMutex -->|Failed| SkipMutex
    SetPostFlag --> CheckNextAgain
    SkipMutex --> CheckNextAgain{Posted Next Events?}
    
    CheckAcceptMutex -->|No| CheckNextAgain
    
    CheckNextAgain -->|Yes| SetTimerZeroAgain[Update Timer to 0]
    CheckNextAgain -->|No| CallProcessEvents
    SetTimerZeroAgain --> CallProcessEvents[Call Platform Event Mechanism<br/>ngx_process_events]
    
    CallProcessEvents --> PlatformEvent{Platform Type}
    
    PlatformEvent -->|Linux| Epoll[epoll_wait<br/>Edge or Level Triggered<br/>Returns ready events]
    PlatformEvent -->|FreeBSD/macOS| Kqueue[kevent<br/>Returns ready events]
    PlatformEvent -->|Windows| IOCP[GetQueuedCompletionStatus<br/>Returns completed I/O]
    PlatformEvent -->|Solaris| EventPorts[port_getn<br/>Returns events]
    PlatformEvent -->|Fallback| Poll[poll/select<br/>Portable mechanism]
    
    Epoll --> ProcessReady[Process Ready Events<br/>Iterate returned events]
    Kqueue --> ProcessReady
    IOCP --> ProcessReady
    EventPorts --> ProcessReady
    Poll --> ProcessReady
    
    ProcessReady --> EventType{Event Type}
    
    EventType -->|Accept Event| PostFlag1{POST_EVENTS Flag?}
    PostFlag1 -->|Yes| QueueAccept[Queue to posted_accept_events]
    PostFlag1 -->|No| HandleAccept[Handle Accept Immediately<br/>ngx_event_accept]
    QueueAccept --> NextEvent
    HandleAccept --> NextEvent{More Events?}
    
    EventType -->|Read Event| PostFlag2{POST_EVENTS Flag?}
    PostFlag2 -->|Yes| QueueEvent[Queue to posted_events]
    PostFlag2 -->|No| HandleRead[Handle Read Immediately<br/>Call read event handler]
    QueueEvent --> NextEvent
    HandleRead --> NextEvent
    
    EventType -->|Write Event| PostFlag3{POST_EVENTS Flag?}
    PostFlag3 -->|Yes| QueueEvent
    PostFlag3 -->|No| HandleWrite[Handle Write Immediately<br/>Call write event handler]
    HandleWrite --> NextEvent
    
    NextEvent -->|Yes| EventType
    NextEvent -->|No| ProcessPostedAccept{Posted Accept Events?}
    
    ProcessPostedAccept -->|Yes| ProcessAccepts[Process All Posted Accepts<br/>ngx_event_process_posted]
    ProcessPostedAccept -->|No| ReleaseMutex
    ProcessAccepts --> ReleaseMutex{Mutex Held?}
    
    ReleaseMutex -->|Yes| UnlockMutex[Release Accept Mutex<br/>Allow other workers]
    ReleaseMutex -->|No| CheckStale
    UnlockMutex --> CheckStale{Events Marked Stale?}
    
    CheckStale -->|Yes| SkipTimer[Skip Timer Processing<br/>Rechecked in next iteration]
    CheckStale -->|No| ExpireTimers[Expire Timers<br/>ngx_event_expire_timers<br/>Process all expired entries]
    
    SkipTimer --> ProcessPosted
    ExpireTimers --> ProcessPosted{Posted Events?<br/>ngx_posted_events queue}
    
    ProcessPosted -->|Yes| ProcessPostedLoop[Process All Posted Events<br/>Event handler calls]
    ProcessPosted -->|No| CheckDelayed
    ProcessPostedLoop --> CheckDelayed{Posted Delayed Events?<br/>Delayed by throttling}
    
    CheckDelayed -->|Yes| ProcessDelayed[Process Delayed Events<br/>Deferred for next iteration]
    CheckDelayed -->|No| UpdateAcceptDisabled
    ProcessDelayed --> UpdateAcceptDisabled[Update accept_disabled Counter<br/>connection_n - free_connection_n<br/>- 7/8 * worker_connections]
    
    UpdateAcceptDisabled --> LoopEnd([Iteration Complete])
    
    LoopEnd --> Start
```

**Event Loop Details**:

- **Timer Calculation**: Determines maximum blocking time for event mechanism. Computed from nearest timer expiration or configured timeout values.

- **Accept Mutex**: Serializes accept across workers when SO_REUSEPORT unavailable. Acquired worker processes all pending accepts before releasing. Prevents thundering herd where all workers wake on new connection.

- **Posted Events**: Events queue for deferred processing. NGX_POST_EVENTS flag delays accept processing until after releasing mutex, ensuring fair distribution. Regular posted events separate high-frequency operations from event polling.

- **Accept Disabled**: Adaptive mechanism disabling accept when worker approaches connection limit (7/8 threshold). Prevents worker from accepting connections it cannot handle.

- **Stale Events**: Events may become stale if connection closes between event notification and processing. Stale flag prevents processing invalid events.

- **Platform Differences**:
  - **epoll** (Linux): Edge-triggered mode requires draining socket buffer. Level-triggered simpler but less efficient.
  - **kqueue** (FreeBSD/macOS): Provides rich event filtering including file changes, signals, timers.
  - **IOCP** (Windows): Completion-based model differs from readiness notification.

### 4.3.2 Connection Accept Flow

Connection acceptance creates new connections from incoming client requests.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Listen Socket Readable]) --> AcceptHandler[ngx_event_accept Handler Invoked]
    
    AcceptHandler --> AcceptLoop{Accept Loop<br/>multi_accept enabled}
    
    AcceptLoop --> SystemAccept[accept4 or accept<br/>System call]
    
    SystemAccept --> AcceptResult{Accept Result}
    
    AcceptResult -->|EAGAIN| NoMoreConnections[No More Pending<br/>Exit accept loop]
    NoMoreConnections --> AcceptComplete([Accept Processing Complete])
    
    AcceptResult -->|EMFILE<br/>ENFILE| FileDescriptorLimit[File Descriptor Limit<br/>Log warning]
    FileDescriptorLimit --> DisableAccept[Disable Accept Events<br/>Temporarily]
    DisableAccept --> ScheduleRetry[Schedule Retry Timer<br/>ngx_accept_disabled]
    ScheduleRetry --> AcceptComplete
    
    AcceptResult -->|Error| LogAcceptError[Log Accept Error]
    LogAcceptError --> ContinueOrExit{Continue?}
    ContinueOrExit -->|multi_accept| AcceptLoop
    ContinueOrExit -->|Single| AcceptComplete
    
    AcceptResult -->|Success| GetConnection[Get Connection from Pool<br/>ngx_get_connection]
    
    GetConnection --> PoolExhausted{Pool Available?}
    PoolExhausted -->|No| CloseSocket[Close Accepted Socket<br/>No connection structures]
    CloseSocket --> LogPoolExhausted[Log Pool Exhausted]
    LogPoolExhausted --> AcceptComplete
    
    PoolExhausted -->|Yes| InitConnection[Initialize Connection Structure<br/>Set socket fd, local/remote addresses]
    
    InitConnection --> SetNonBlocking[Set Socket Non-Blocking<br/>fcntl O_NONBLOCK or ioctl FIONBIO]
    
    SetNonBlocking --> SetOptions[Set Socket Options<br/>TCP_NODELAY disable Nagle<br/>TCP_NOPUSH/TCP_CORK if configured]
    
    SetOptions --> CreatePool[Create Connection Memory Pool<br/>connection_pool_size bytes]
    
    CreatePool --> AllocLog[Allocate Log Context<br/>Per-connection error logging]
    
    AllocLog --> GetSockOpt[Get Socket Options<br/>rcvbuf, sndbuf values]
    
    GetSockOpt --> SetHandler{Listening Socket Handler Type}
    
    SetHandler -->|HTTP| HTTPInitConn[Set Handler:<br/>ngx_http_init_connection]
    SetHandler -->|Stream| StreamInitConn[Set Handler:<br/>ngx_stream_init_connection]
    SetHandler -->|Mail| MailInitConn[Set Handler:<br/>ngx_mail_init_connection]
    
    HTTPInitConn --> AddReadEvent[Add Read Event to Event Mechanism<br/>Wait for client data]
    StreamInitConn --> AddReadEvent
    MailInitConn --> AddReadEvent
    
    AddReadEvent --> SetTimeout[Set Read Timeout<br/>client_header_timeout for HTTP<br/>proxy_timeout for stream]
    
    SetTimeout --> CheckSSL{SSL Configured?}
    CheckSSL -->|Yes| InitSSL[Initialize SSL Connection<br/>See Section 4.7.1]
    CheckSSL -->|No| WaitData[Wait for Client Data<br/>Event-driven read]
    InitSSL --> WaitData
    
    WaitData --> MultiAccept{multi_accept Enabled?}
    MultiAccept -->|Yes| AcceptLoop
    MultiAccept -->|No| AcceptComplete
```

**Connection Accept Details**:

- **accept4 vs accept**: Linux accept4 allows setting O_NONBLOCK and O_CLOEXEC atomically. Fallback to accept with subsequent fcntl on other platforms.

- **Connection Pool Management**: Pre-allocated connection structures (worker_connections) assigned from pool. Pool exhaustion prevents new accepts until connections free.

- **Socket Options**:
  - **TCP_NODELAY**: Disables Nagle algorithm for low-latency response
  - **TCP_NOPUSH** (FreeBSD) / **TCP_CORK** (Linux): Delays packet transmission until buffer full or explicitly flushed
  - **SO_KEEPALIVE**: TCP keepalive probes for dead connection detection

- **multi_accept**: When enabled, processes all pending connections in single event notification. Improves throughput under load but may starve other events.

- **File Descriptor Limits**: EMFILE (process limit) or ENFILE (system limit) errors temporarily disable accept events. Timer re-enables after delay (ngx_accept_disabled).

### 4.3.3 Timer Management

Timer management through red-black tree enables efficient timeout enforcement across thousands of connections.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Timer Management]) --> Structure[Timer Red-Black Tree<br/>Keyed by expiration time<br/>Minimum at leftmost node]
    
    Structure --> Operations{Timer Operation}
    
    Operations -->|Add Timer| AddTimer[ngx_add_timer]
    AddTimer --> ComputeExpiry[Compute Expiry Time<br/>ngx_current_msec + timeout]
    ComputeExpiry --> InsertRBTree[Insert into RBTree<br/>O log n complexity]
    InsertRBTree --> TimerActive[Timer Active]
    
    Operations -->|Delete Timer| DelTimer[ngx_del_timer]
    DelTimer --> CheckActive{Timer Active?}
    CheckActive -->|Yes| RemoveRBTree[Remove from RBTree<br/>O log n complexity]
    CheckActive -->|No| NoOp[No Operation]
    RemoveRBTree --> TimerInactive[Timer Inactive]
    NoOp --> TimerInactive
    
    Operations -->|Find Next Expiry| FindNext[ngx_event_find_timer]
    FindNext --> CheckEmpty{Tree Empty?}
    CheckEmpty -->|Yes| ReturnInfinite[Return NGX_TIMER_INFINITE<br/>No active timers]
    CheckEmpty -->|No| GetLeftmost[Get Leftmost Node<br/>Minimum expiry time]
    GetLeftmost --> ComputeDelta[Compute Delta<br/>expiry - ngx_current_msec]
    ComputeDelta --> CheckExpired{Delta <= 0?}
    CheckExpired -->|Yes| ReturnZero[Return 0<br/>Already expired]
    CheckExpired -->|No| ReturnDelta[Return Delta<br/>Time until next expiry]
    
    Operations -->|Expire Timers| ExpireTimers[ngx_event_expire_timers]
    ExpireTimers --> UpdateCurrentTime[Update ngx_current_msec<br/>Cache current time]
    UpdateCurrentTime --> ExpireLoop{Tree Empty?}
    ExpireLoop -->|Yes| ExpireComplete([Expiration Complete])
    ExpireLoop -->|No| GetMin[Get Minimum Timer<br/>Leftmost node]
    GetMin --> CheckExpiry{Expired?<br/>key <= ngx_current_msec}
    CheckExpiry -->|No| ExpireComplete
    CheckExpiry -->|Yes| RemoveTimer[Remove from Tree]
    RemoveTimer --> SetTimeoutFlag[Set event->timeout = 1<br/>Mark as timeout]
    SetTimeoutFlag --> CallHandler[Call Event Handler<br/>event->handler]
    CallHandler --> ExpireLoop
    
    subgraph "Common Timer Types"
        ClientHeader[client_header_timeout<br/>Waiting for request headers]
        ClientBody[client_body_timeout<br/>Reading request body]
        SendTimeout[send_timeout<br/>Sending response to client]
        Keepalive[keepalive_timeout<br/>Idle keepalive connection]
        ProxyConnect[proxy_connect_timeout<br/>Connecting to upstream]
        ProxyRead[proxy_read_timeout<br/>Reading from upstream]
        ProxySend[proxy_send_timeout<br/>Sending to upstream]
        ResolverTimeout[resolver_timeout<br/>DNS resolution]
    end
    
    TimerActive -.-> ClientHeader
    TimerActive -.-> ClientBody
    TimerActive -.-> SendTimeout
    TimerActive -.-> Keepalive
    TimerActive -.-> ProxyConnect
    TimerActive -.-> ProxyRead
    TimerActive -.-> ProxySend
    TimerActive -.-> ResolverTimeout
```

**Timer Management Details**:

- **Red-Black Tree**: Self-balancing binary search tree maintains O(log n) insertion, deletion, and search. Minimum element (next expiration) always at leftmost node enables O(1) retrieval.

- **Time Caching**: ngx_current_msec caches current time updated once per event loop iteration or timer expiration. Avoids expensive gettimeofday system calls for each timer check.

- **Timer Precision**: Millisecond precision sufficient for network timeouts. Configuration directives accept seconds but store as milliseconds internally.

- **Timer Coalescing**: Multiple events may expire in single iteration. Expiration loop processes all expired timers before returning to main event loop.

- **Timeout Event Handler**: Event handlers check `event->timeout` flag distinguishing timeout from normal I/O completion. Timeouts typically trigger error responses or connection closure.

## 4.4 HTTP Protocol Flows

### 4.4.1 HTTP/1.x Request Lifecycle

The complete HTTP/1.x request processing flow from connection initialization through response transmission. This expands upon the foundational flowchart in Section 2.7.1 with implementation details.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Connection Established]) --> HTTPInitConn[ngx_http_init_connection<br/>src/http/ngx_http_request.c]
    
    HTTPInitConn --> DetermineServerConf[Determine Server Configuration<br/>From listening address]
    
    DetermineServerConf --> AllocHTTPConn[Allocate HTTP Connection Context<br/>From connection pool]
    
    AllocHTTPConn --> SetWaitHandler[Set Read Handler:<br/>ngx_http_wait_request_handler]
    
    SetWaitHandler --> AddHeaderTimeout[Add Timer:<br/>client_header_timeout]
    
    AddHeaderTimeout --> CheckProxyProtocol{PROXY Protocol Enabled?}
    CheckProxyProtocol -->|Yes| ParseProxyProtocol[Parse PROXY Protocol Header<br/>Extract real client address]
    CheckProxyProtocol -->|No| WaitForData
    ParseProxyProtocol --> WaitForData[Wait for Request Data<br/>Event-driven read]
    
    WaitForData --> DataArrives[Read Event Triggered]
    
    DataArrives --> ReadData[Read from Socket<br/>recv into buffer]
    
    ReadData --> ReadResult{Read Result}
    ReadResult -->|Error| CloseError[Close Connection<br/>Log error]
    ReadResult -->|EOF| CloseEOF[Close Connection<br/>Premature client disconnect]
    ReadResult -->|EAGAIN| WaitForData
    
    ReadResult -->|Data| CheckHTTP2Preface{HTTP/2 Preface?<br/>PRI * HTTP/2.0...}
    CheckHTTP2Preface -->|Yes| SwitchHTTP2[Switch to HTTP/2 Handler<br/>See Section 4.4.2]
    CheckHTTP2Preface -->|No| CheckHTTP3{HTTP/3 over QUIC?}
    CheckHTTP3 -->|Yes| HandleHTTP3[Handle HTTP/3<br/>See Section 4.4.3]
    
    CheckHTTP3 -->|No| CreateRequest[Create Request<br/>ngx_http_create_request<br/>Allocate request pool]
    
    CreateRequest --> InitRequest[Initialize Request Structure<br/>Headers in/out, variables]
    
    InitRequest --> SetLineHandler[Set Read Handler:<br/>ngx_http_process_request_line]
    
    SetLineHandler --> ParseRequestLine[Parse Request Line<br/>ngx_http_parse_request_line<br/>Incremental state machine]
    
    ParseRequestLine --> LineResult{Parse Result}
    LineResult -->|NGX_AGAIN| ReadMore1[Read More Data<br/>Need more bytes]
    ReadMore1 --> WaitForData
    
    LineResult -->|NGX_ERROR| BadRequest[Return 400 Bad Request<br/>Invalid request line]
    
    LineResult -->|NGX_OK| ExtractMethod[Extract Method<br/>GET, POST, PUT, etc.]
    
    ExtractMethod --> ValidateMethod{Method Allowed?}
    ValidateMethod -->|No| MethodNotAllowed[Return 405 Method Not Allowed]
    ValidateMethod -->|Yes| ExtractURI[Extract URI and Args<br/>Parse path and query string]
    
    ExtractURI --> ValidateURI{URI Valid?}
    ValidateURI -->|Too Long| URITooLong[Return 414 URI Too Long]
    ValidateURI -->|Invalid Chars| BadRequest
    ValidateURI -->|Valid| ExtractVersion[Extract HTTP Version<br/>HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1]
    
    ExtractVersion --> SetHeaderHandler[Set Read Handler:<br/>ngx_http_process_request_headers]
    
    SetHeaderHandler --> ParseHeaders[Parse Headers Loop<br/>ngx_http_parse_header_line]
    
    ParseHeaders --> HeaderResult{Parse Result}
    HeaderResult -->|NGX_AGAIN| ReadMore2[Read More Data]
    ReadMore2 --> WaitForData
    
    HeaderResult -->|NGX_ERROR| BadRequest
    HeaderResult -->|NGX_HTTP_PARSE_INVALID_HEADER| BadRequest
    
    HeaderResult -->|NGX_OK| ProcessHeader[Process Header<br/>Map to handler]
    
    ProcessHeader --> HeaderType{Header Type}
    HeaderType -->|Host| ProcessHost[Process Host Header<br/>Virtual server selection]
    HeaderType -->|Content-Length| ProcessContentLength[Process Content-Length<br/>Request body size]
    HeaderType -->|Transfer-Encoding| ProcessTransferEncoding[Check for chunked]
    HeaderType -->|Connection| ProcessConnection[Check keepalive/close]
    HeaderType -->|Expect| ProcessExpect[Handle 100-continue]
    HeaderType -->|Other| StoreHeader[Store in Headers In]
    
    ProcessHost --> ParseHeaders
    ProcessContentLength --> ParseHeaders
    ProcessTransferEncoding --> ParseHeaders
    ProcessConnection --> ParseHeaders
    ProcessExpect --> ParseHeaders
    StoreHeader --> ParseHeaders
    
    HeaderResult -->|NGX_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_DONE| AllHeadersDone[All Headers Parsed<br/>ngx_http_process_request_header]
    
    AllHeadersDone --> ValidateHost{Host Header Present?<br/>Required for HTTP/1.1}
    ValidateHost -->|No| BadRequest
    ValidateHost -->|Yes| FindVirtualServer[Find Virtual Server<br/>Match Host against server_name]
    
    FindVirtualServer --> FindLocation[Find Location Block<br/>Match URI against locations<br/>Exact > Prefix > Regex]
    
    FindLocation --> CheckRequestBody{Request Body Expected?<br/>Content-Length > 0 or chunked}
    CheckRequestBody -->|Yes| ReadBody[Read Request Body<br/>ngx_http_read_client_request_body<br/>May use temp file for large bodies]
    CheckRequestBody -->|No| StartProcessing
    ReadBody --> StartProcessing[Start Request Processing<br/>ngx_http_handler]
    
    StartProcessing --> InitPhaseIndex[Initialize phase_handler Index<br/>Start at phase 0]
    
    InitPhaseIndex --> SetWriteHandler[Set Write Event Handler:<br/>ngx_http_core_run_phases]
    
    SetWriteHandler --> RunPhases[Execute Phase Engine<br/>ngx_http_core_run_phases<br/>See Section 4.4.4]
    
    RunPhases --> PhaseComplete{Phase Result}
    PhaseComplete -->|NGX_OK| NextPhase[Continue to Next Phase]
    PhaseComplete -->|NGX_DECLINED| NextHandler[Try Next Handler in Phase]
    PhaseComplete -->|NGX_AGAIN<br/>NGX_DONE| Suspend[Suspend Processing<br/>Resume on event]
    PhaseComplete -->|NGX_ERROR| InternalError[Return 500 Internal Server Error]
    PhaseComplete -->|Status Code| FinalizeRequest
    
    NextPhase --> PhaseCheck{More Phases?}
    PhaseCheck -->|Yes| RunPhases
    PhaseCheck -->|No| ContentGenerated[Content Generated]
    NextHandler --> RunPhases
    
    ContentGenerated --> FilterHeaders[Header Filter Chain<br/>ngx_http_top_header_filter]
    
    FilterHeaders --> SendHeaders[Send Response Headers<br/>Format HTTP response]
    
    SendHeaders --> FilterBody[Body Filter Chain<br/>ngx_http_top_body_filter]
    
    FilterBody --> SendBody[Send Response Body<br/>ngx_http_write_filter]
    
    SendBody --> WriteResult{Write Complete?}
    WriteResult -->|NGX_AGAIN| WaitWritable[Wait for Socket Writable<br/>Add write event]
    WaitWritable --> SendBody
    WriteResult -->|NGX_ERROR| CloseError
    WriteResult -->|NGX_OK| FinalizeRequest[Finalize Request<br/>ngx_http_finalize_request]
    
    FinalizeRequest --> LogRequest[Log Request<br/>ngx_http_log_request<br/>Access log entry]
    
    LogRequest --> CloseRequest[Close Request<br/>ngx_http_close_request<br/>Destroy request pool]
    
    CloseRequest --> CheckKeepalive{Keepalive?<br/>Connection: keep-alive}
    CheckKeepalive -->|Yes| SetKeepalive[Set Keepalive State<br/>ngx_http_set_keepalive]
    CheckKeepalive -->|No| CheckLingering{Lingering Close?<br/>Request body not fully read}
    
    SetKeepalive --> KeepaliveTimeout[Add Keepalive Timeout<br/>keepalive_timeout]
    KeepaliveTimeout --> CheckKeepaliveCount{Keepalive Count Exceeded?<br/>keepalive_requests}
    CheckKeepaliveCount -->|Yes| CloseConnection
    CheckKeepaliveCount -->|No| ResetParser[Reset Parser State<br/>Reuse connection]
    ResetParser --> WaitForData
    
    CheckLingering -->|Yes| LingeringClose[Lingering Close<br/>ngx_http_set_lingering_close<br/>Read and discard remaining data]
    CheckLingering -->|No| CloseConnection[Close Connection<br/>ngx_http_close_connection]
    LingeringClose --> CloseConnection
    
    CloseConnection --> FreeConnection[Free Connection Structure<br/>Return to pool]
    FreeConnection --> End([Connection Closed])
    
    BadRequest --> FinalizeRequest
    MethodNotAllowed --> FinalizeRequest
    URITooLong --> FinalizeRequest
    InternalError --> FinalizeRequest
    CloseError --> End
    CloseEOF --> End
    Suspend -.-> WaitForData
    SwitchHTTP2 -.-> End
    HandleHTTP3 -.-> End
```

**HTTP/1.x Processing Details**:

- **Incremental Parsing**: State machines process bytes as they arrive, enabling non-blocking operation. Parser maintains state across multiple read events.

- **Virtual Server Selection**: Host header matching against server_name directives with priority: exact match > left wildcard (*.example.com) > right wildcard (www.example.*) > regex. Default server selected if no match.

- **Location Matching**: URI matched against location blocks with priority: exact match (=) > longest prefix match (^~) > regex match (~, ~*) > prefix match. Internal locations (@name) accessible only via internal redirects.

- **Request Body Handling**: Small bodies buffer in memory. Large bodies (exceeding client_body_buffer_size) write to temporary files. Thread pools may handle blocking file operations.

- **Keepalive Management**: Reuses connection for multiple requests. Limits: keepalive_timeout (idle time), keepalive_requests (max requests per connection). Resets parser but preserves connection pool and SSL session.

- **Lingering Close**: Reads and discards remaining request body before closing connection, preventing TCP RST and ensuring clean shutdown. Configured via lingering_close (on/off/always) and lingering_timeout.

### 4.4.2 HTTP/2 Frame Processing and Stream Multiplexing

HTTP/2 implements binary frame-based multiplexing over single TCP connection. This flow details frame processing and stream lifecycle.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([HTTP/2 Connection]) --> VerifyPreface[Verify Connection Preface<br/>PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n]
    
    VerifyPreface --> PrefaceValid{Preface Valid?}
    PrefaceValid -->|No| SendGoaway[Send GOAWAY Frame<br/>PROTOCOL_ERROR]
    SendGoaway --> CloseConnection[Close Connection]
    
    PrefaceValid -->|Yes| InitH2Connection[Initialize HTTP/2 Connection<br/>ngx_http_v2_init<br/>src/http/v2/ngx_http_v2.c]
    
    InitH2Connection --> AllocH2Context[Allocate H2 Connection Context<br/>HPACK dynamic table 4KB<br/>Stream hash table<br/>Flow control windows]
    
    AllocH2Context --> SendSettings[Send SETTINGS Frame<br/>MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS<br/>INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE<br/>MAX_FRAME_SIZE<br/>MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE]
    
    SendSettings --> SendWindowUpdate[Send Initial WINDOW_UPDATE<br/>Connection-level flow control]
    
    SendWindowUpdate --> SetReadHandler[Set Read Handler:<br/>ngx_http_v2_read_handler]
    
    SetReadHandler --> FrameLoop[Frame Processing Loop]
    
    FrameLoop --> ReadFrameHeader[Read Frame Header 9 bytes<br/>Length 24-bit<br/>Type 8-bit<br/>Flags 8-bit<br/>Stream ID 31-bit]
    
    ReadFrameHeader --> HeaderComplete{Header Complete?}
    HeaderComplete -->|No| WaitMoreData[Wait for More Data<br/>NGX_AGAIN]
    HeaderComplete -->|Yes| ValidateFrame{Validate Frame}
    
    ValidateFrame -->|Length > MAX| FrameSizeError[FRAME_SIZE_ERROR<br/>Send GOAWAY]
    FrameSizeError --> CloseConnection
    
    ValidateFrame -->|Invalid Stream ID| ProtocolError[PROTOCOL_ERROR<br/>Send GOAWAY]
    ProtocolError --> CloseConnection
    
    ValidateFrame -->|Valid| DispatchFrame{Frame Type}
    
    DispatchFrame -->|DATA 0x00| ProcessData[Process DATA Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_data]
    DispatchFrame -->|HEADERS 0x01| ProcessHeaders[Process HEADERS Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_headers]
    DispatchFrame -->|PRIORITY 0x02| ProcessPriority[Process PRIORITY Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_priority]
    DispatchFrame -->|RST_STREAM 0x03| ProcessRstStream[Process RST_STREAM Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_rst_stream]
    DispatchFrame -->|SETTINGS 0x04| ProcessSettings[Process SETTINGS Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_settings]
    DispatchFrame -->|PUSH_PROMISE 0x05| RejectPush[Reject PUSH_PROMISE<br/>Server doesn't accept]
    DispatchFrame -->|PING 0x06| ProcessPing[Process PING Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_ping]
    DispatchFrame -->|GOAWAY 0x07| ProcessGoaway[Process GOAWAY Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_goaway]
    DispatchFrame -->|WINDOW_UPDATE 0x08| ProcessWindowUpdate[Process WINDOW_UPDATE Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_window_update]
    DispatchFrame -->|CONTINUATION 0x09| ProcessContinuation[Process CONTINUATION Frame<br/>ngx_http_v2_state_continuation]
    DispatchFrame -->|Unknown| IgnoreFrame[Ignore Unknown Frame<br/>Per RFC requirement]
    
    ProcessHeaders --> CheckStreamID{Stream ID Valid?<br/>Must be odd, > last}
    CheckStreamID -->|No| StreamError[Stream Error<br/>Send RST_STREAM]
    CheckStreamID -->|Yes| CheckStreamLimit{Max Concurrent Reached?}
    CheckStreamLimit -->|Yes| RefusedStream[REFUSED_STREAM<br/>Send RST_STREAM]
    CheckStreamLimit -->|No| CreateStream[Create New Stream<br/>Allocate stream context<br/>Insert into stream hash]
    
    CreateStream --> CreateFakeConnection[Create Fake ngx_connection_t<br/>Stream appears as connection]
    
    CreateFakeConnection --> CreateRequest[Create ngx_http_request_t<br/>Map stream to HTTP request]
    
    CreateRequest --> DecodeHPACK[Decode HPACK Headers<br/>Process indexed/literal fields<br/>Update dynamic table]
    
    DecodeHPACK --> HPACKResult{HPACK Result}
    HPACKResult -->|Error| CompressionError[COMPRESSION_ERROR<br/>Send GOAWAY]
    CompressionError --> CloseConnection
    
    HPACKResult -->|Success| ExtractPseudoHeaders[Extract Pseudo-Headers<br/>:method, :path, :scheme, :authority]
    
    ExtractPseudoHeaders --> ValidatePseudo{Pseudo-Headers Valid?}
    ValidatePseudo -->|No| ProtocolError
    ValidatePseudo -->|Yes| ConstructRequest[Construct HTTP Request<br/>Map H2 to HTTP/1.1 semantics]
    
    ConstructRequest --> CheckEndHeaders{END_HEADERS Flag?}
    CheckEndHeaders -->|No| ExpectContinuation[Expect CONTINUATION Frame<br/>Store partial headers]
    ExpectContinuation --> FrameLoop
    
    CheckEndHeaders -->|Yes| CheckEndStream{END_STREAM Flag?}
    CheckEndStream -->|Yes| NoBodyExpected[No Request Body]
    CheckEndStream -->|No| ExpectData[Expect DATA Frames]
    
    NoBodyExpected --> StartRequestProcessing[Start Request Processing<br/>ngx_http_handler<br/>HTTP phase engine]
    ExpectData --> StartRequestProcessing
    
    StartRequestProcessing --> PhaseEngine[Execute HTTP Phase Engine<br/>Same as HTTP/1.x]
    
    ProcessData --> CheckFlowControl{Flow Control Window?<br/>Stream and connection level}
    CheckFlowControl -->|Exceeded| FlowControlError[FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR<br/>Send RST_STREAM or GOAWAY]
    FlowControlError --> FrameLoop
    
    CheckFlowControl -->|OK| UpdateWindow[Update Flow Control Windows<br/>Decrement by data length]
    
    UpdateWindow --> DeliverData[Deliver Data to Request<br/>Append to request body buffer]
    
    DeliverData --> CheckDataEnd{END_STREAM Flag?}
    CheckDataEnd -->|Yes| BodyComplete[Request Body Complete]
    CheckDataEnd -->|No| ContinueReading[Continue Reading DATA]
    ContinueReading --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessSettings --> CheckAck{ACK Flag?}
    CheckAck -->|Yes| SettingsAckReceived[Settings Acknowledged<br/>Apply pending settings]
    CheckAck -->|No| ParseSettings[Parse Settings Parameters<br/>HEADER_TABLE_SIZE<br/>ENABLE_PUSH<br/>MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS<br/>INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE<br/>MAX_FRAME_SIZE<br/>MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE]
    
    ParseSettings --> ValidateSettings{Settings Valid?}
    ValidateSettings -->|No| ProtocolError
    ValidateSettings -->|Yes| ApplySettings[Apply Settings<br/>Update connection context]
    
    ApplySettings --> SendSettingsAck[Send SETTINGS Frame<br/>with ACK flag]
    SendSettingsAck --> FrameLoop
    SettingsAckReceived --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessPing --> CheckPingAck{ACK Flag?}
    CheckPingAck -->|Yes| PingReceived[Ping Response Received]
    CheckPingAck -->|No| SendPingReply[Send PING Frame<br/>with ACK flag<br/>Echo opaque data]
    SendPingReply --> FrameLoop
    PingReceived --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessWindowUpdate --> UpdateFlowWindow{Stream or Connection?<br/>Stream ID 0 = connection}
    UpdateFlowWindow -->|Connection| UpdateConnWindow[Update Connection Window<br/>Resume blocked streams]
    UpdateFlowWindow -->|Stream| UpdateStreamWindow[Update Stream Window<br/>Resume stream sending]
    UpdateConnWindow --> FrameLoop
    UpdateStreamWindow --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessRstStream --> ExtractError[Extract Error Code<br/>CANCEL, REFUSED_STREAM, etc.]
    ExtractError --> CloseStream[Close Stream<br/>Clean up stream context]
    CloseStream --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessGoaway --> ExtractLastStreamID[Extract Last Stream ID<br/>Extract error code]
    ExtractLastStreamID --> MarkClosing[Mark Connection Closing<br/>No new streams]
    MarkClosing --> DrainStreams[Drain Active Streams]
    DrainStreams --> CloseConnection
    
    PhaseEngine --> GenerateResponse[Generate Response<br/>Content handler executed]
    
    GenerateResponse --> SendHeadersFrame[Send HEADERS Frame<br/>HPACK encode response headers<br/>:status pseudo-header]
    
    SendHeadersFrame --> SendDataFrames[Send DATA Frames<br/>Fragment body into frames<br/>Respect MAX_FRAME_SIZE]
    
    SendDataFrames --> CheckFlowOut{Flow Control Available?}
    CheckFlowOut -->|No| BlockStream[Block Stream<br/>Wait for WINDOW_UPDATE]
    CheckFlowOut -->|Yes| SendData[Send DATA Frame<br/>Update flow control window]
    
    SendData --> MoreData{More Body Data?}
    MoreData -->|Yes| SendDataFrames
    MoreData -->|No| SendFinalData[Send Final DATA Frame<br/>with END_STREAM flag]
    
    SendFinalData --> StreamComplete[Stream Complete<br/>Clean up stream context]
    
    StreamComplete --> FrameLoop
    
    RejectPush --> SendRstStream[Send RST_STREAM<br/>REFUSED_STREAM]
    SendRstStream --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessPriority --> UpdatePriorityTree[Update Priority Tree<br/>Stream dependency and weight]
    UpdatePriorityTree --> FrameLoop
    
    ProcessContinuation --> CheckContinuationStream{Expected Stream?}
    CheckContinuationStream -->|No| ProtocolError
    CheckContinuationStream -->|Yes| AppendHeaders[Append to Header Block]
    AppendHeaders --> CheckContEnd{END_HEADERS Flag?}
    CheckContEnd -->|No| ExpectMoreContinuation[Expect More CONTINUATION]
    ExpectMoreContinuation --> FrameLoop
    CheckContEnd -->|Yes| ProcessHeaders
    
    IgnoreFrame --> ReadPayload[Read and Discard Payload<br/>Frame length bytes]
    ReadPayload --> FrameLoop
    
    StreamError --> SendRstStream
    RefusedStream --> SendRstStream
    BodyComplete --> PhaseEngine
    BlockStream --> FrameLoop
    WaitMoreData -.-> FrameLoop
    
    CloseConnection --> End([Connection Terminated])
```

**HTTP/2 Implementation Details**:

- **HPACK Compression**: Dynamic table (default 4KB) stores frequently used headers. Static table (61 entries) contains common HTTP headers. Huffman encoding reduces header size further. Compression context shared across all streams on connection.

- **Flow Control**: Two-level flow control prevents fast sender overwhelming slow receiver. Connection-level window applies to all streams. Per-stream window controls individual stream. WINDOW_UPDATE frames increment windows. Default initial window: 65,535 bytes.

- **Stream Multiplexing**: Multiple concurrent streams (default limit: unlimited, configurable via http2_max_concurrent_streams). Stream IDs: client-initiated odd, server-initiated even. Streams independent; loss on one doesn't block others at HTTP/2 layer (TCP still has head-of-line blocking).

- **Priority and Dependencies**: Streams form dependency tree with weights (1-256). Scheduler allocates bandwidth proportionally based on weights. Exclusive flag restructures tree. NGINX implements weighted fair queuing scheduler.

- **Frame Size Limits**: Maximum frame size negotiated via SETTINGS (default 16KB, max 16MB). Large payloads fragment across multiple frames. Receivers must accept frames up to MAX_FRAME_SIZE.

- **Error Handling**: Stream errors send RST_STREAM closing individual stream. Connection errors send GOAWAY closing entire connection. Error codes indicate reason (PROTOCOL_ERROR, FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR, etc.).

### 4.4.3 HTTP/3 and QUIC Connection Flow

HTTP/3 builds on QUIC transport, providing encrypted multiplexed HTTP over UDP.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([UDP Datagram Received]) --> QUICInput[QUIC Input Handler<br/>ngx_quic_input_handler<br/>src/event/quic/ngx_event_quic.c]
    
    QUICInput --> ParsePacketHeader[Parse QUIC Packet Header<br/>Long header: Initial/0-RTT/Handshake<br/>Short header: 1-RTT]
    
    ParsePacketHeader --> HeaderType{Header Type}
    
    HeaderType -->|Initial| ParseInitial[Parse Initial Packet<br/>Extract DCID, SCID, version<br/>Token, packet number]
    
    ParseInitial --> CheckVersion{Supported Version?}
    CheckVersion -->|No| SendVersionNegotiation[Send Version Negotiation<br/>List supported versions]
    SendVersionNegotiation --> End([Packet Processed])
    
    CheckVersion -->|Yes| LookupConnection{Connection Exists?<br/>Lookup by DCID}
    
    LookupConnection -->|No| CreateConnection[Create QUIC Connection<br/>ngx_quic_new_connection]
    
    CreateConnection --> ValidateToken{Address Validation Token?}
    ValidateToken -->|Invalid/None| SendRetry[Send Retry Packet<br/>Include address token<br/>Force client validation]
    SendRetry --> End
    
    ValidateToken -->|Valid| AllocQUICContext[Allocate QUIC Context<br/>Connection IDs<br/>Crypto contexts<br/>Stream management]
    
    AllocQUICContext --> InitTLSHandshake[Initialize TLS 1.3 Handshake<br/>OpenSSL integration<br/>Extract ClientHello]
    
    InitTLSHandshake --> ProcessCryptoFrame[Process CRYPTO Frame<br/>TLS handshake messages]
    
    ProcessCryptoFrame --> TLSResult{TLS Result}
    TLSResult -->|Need More| SendCrypto[Send CRYPTO Frame<br/>ServerHello, Certificate, etc.<br/>in Initial or Handshake packets]
    SendCrypto --> End
    
    TLSResult -->|Error| SendConnectionClose[Send CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame<br/>Crypto error code]
    SendConnectionClose --> End
    
    TLSResult -->|Success| DeriveKeys[Derive QUIC Keys<br/>Initial, Handshake, Application<br/>Per TLS 1.3 key schedule]
    
    DeriveKeys --> SendHandshakeDone[Send HANDSHAKE_DONE Frame<br/>Confirm handshake completion]
    
    SendHandshakeDone --> EstablishStreams[Establish Control Streams<br/>HTTP/3 SETTINGS stream]
    
    EstablishStreams --> ConnectionEstablished[QUIC Connection Established<br/>Ready for HTTP/3]
    
    LookupConnection -->|Yes| GetConnection[Get Existing Connection]
    
    GetConnection --> DecryptPacket[Decrypt Packet<br/>Use appropriate encryption level<br/>Initial/Handshake/Application]
    
    DecryptPacket --> DecryptResult{Decrypt Success?}
    DecryptResult -->|No| DiscardPacket[Discard Packet<br/>Log decryption failure]
    DiscardPacket --> End
    
    DecryptResult -->|Yes| VerifyPacketNumber[Verify Packet Number<br/>Check for replay<br/>Update largest received]
    
    VerifyPacketNumber --> ParseFrames[Parse QUIC Frames<br/>Multiple frames per packet]
    
    ParseFrames --> FrameType{Frame Type}
    
    FrameType -->|CRYPTO| ProcessCryptoFrame
    
    FrameType -->|STREAM| ProcessStreamFrame[Process STREAM Frame<br/>ngx_quic_stream_handler]
    
    ProcessStreamFrame --> ExtractStreamID[Extract Stream ID<br/>0x00-0x03: type selector<br/>Client/Server, Bidi/Uni]
    
    ExtractStreamID --> FindStream{Stream Exists?}
    FindStream -->|No| CreateStream[Create QUIC Stream<br/>Check stream limits]
    FindStream -->|Yes| GetStream[Get Existing Stream]
    
    CreateStream --> CheckStreamType{Stream Type?}
    GetStream --> CheckStreamType
    
    CheckStreamType -->|Control Stream| ProcessControl[Process Control Stream<br/>HTTP/3 SETTINGS, GOAWAY]
    CheckStreamType -->|QPACK Encoder| ProcessQPACKEnc[Process QPACK Encoder Stream<br/>Dynamic table updates]
    CheckStreamType -->|QPACK Decoder| ProcessQPACKDec[Process QPACK Decoder Stream<br/>Acknowledgments]
    CheckStreamType -->|Request Stream| ProcessRequest[Process Request Stream<br/>Bidirectional, client-initiated]
    
    ProcessControl --> ParseH3Frame[Parse HTTP/3 Frame<br/>HEADERS, DATA, SETTINGS<br/>GOAWAY, CANCEL_PUSH]
    
    ProcessRequest --> ParseH3Frame
    
    ParseH3Frame --> H3FrameType{HTTP/3 Frame Type}
    
    H3FrameType -->|HEADERS| DecodeQPACK[Decode QPACK Headers<br/>Static table + dynamic table<br/>Encoder/decoder streams]
    
    DecodeQPACK --> QPACKResult{QPACK Result}
    QPACKResult -->|Blocked| WaitDynamicTable[Wait for Dynamic Table Updates<br/>Blocked by encoder stream]
    WaitDynamicTable --> End
    
    QPACKResult -->|Error| SendH3Error[Send H3_QPACK_DECOMPRESSION_FAILED]
    SendH3Error --> CloseStream[Close Stream<br/>STOP_SENDING + RESET_STREAM]
    CloseStream --> End
    
    QPACKResult -->|Success| ExtractHeaders[Extract HTTP Headers<br/>:method, :path, :scheme, :authority<br/>Regular headers]
    
    ExtractHeaders --> CreateH3Request[Create HTTP/3 Request<br/>Map to ngx_http_request_t]
    
    CreateH3Request --> H3PhaseEngine[Execute HTTP Phase Engine<br/>Same as HTTP/1.x and HTTP/2]
    
    H3FrameType -->|DATA| DeliverData[Deliver Request Body Data<br/>Append to request body buffer]
    
    DeliverData --> CheckFin{FIN Flag?}
    CheckFin -->|Yes| BodyComplete[Request Body Complete]
    CheckFin -->|No| MoreDataExpected[More DATA Frames Expected]
    BodyComplete --> H3PhaseEngine
    MoreDataExpected --> End
    
    H3FrameType -->|SETTINGS| ParseSettings[Parse HTTP/3 SETTINGS<br/>QPACK_MAX_TABLE_CAPACITY<br/>MAX_FIELD_SECTION_SIZE<br/>QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS]
    ParseSettings --> StoreSettings[Store Settings<br/>Apply to connection]
    StoreSettings --> End
    
    H3PhaseEngine --> GenerateH3Response[Generate HTTP/3 Response]
    
    GenerateH3Response --> EncodeQPACKHeaders[Encode Response Headers<br/>QPACK compression]
    
    EncodeQPACKHeaders --> SendHeadersFrame[Send HTTP/3 HEADERS Frame<br/>On request stream]
    
    SendHeadersFrame --> SendDataFrames[Send HTTP/3 DATA Frames<br/>Fragment body]
    
    SendDataFrames --> FlowControlCheck{QUIC Flow Control OK?<br/>Stream and connection level}
    FlowControlCheck -->|No| BlockSending[Block Sending<br/>Wait for MAX_STREAM_DATA]
    FlowControlCheck -->|Yes| SendStreamData[Send STREAM Frames<br/>Encapsulated DATA]
    
    SendStreamData --> UpdateFlowControl[Update Flow Control State<br/>Decrement available window]
    
    UpdateFlowControl --> MoreBody{More Response Body?}
    MoreBody -->|Yes| SendDataFrames
    MoreBody -->|No| SendFin[Send STREAM Frame with FIN<br/>Close sending direction]
    
    SendFin --> StreamComplete[HTTP/3 Stream Complete]
    StreamComplete --> End
    
    FrameType -->|ACK| ProcessACK[Process ACK Frame<br/>Update packet tracking<br/>Detect lost packets]
    
    ProcessACK --> UpdateRTT[Update RTT Estimate<br/>Smoothed RTT, RTT variance]
    
    UpdateRTT --> DetectLoss[Loss Detection<br/>Packet threshold: 3 packets later ACKed<br/>Time threshold: PTO timer]
    
    DetectLoss --> LostPackets{Packets Lost?}
    LostPackets -->|Yes| MarkLost[Mark Packets Lost<br/>Trigger retransmission]
    MarkLost --> RetransmitFrames[Retransmit CRYPTO/STREAM Frames<br/>In new packets]
    RetransmitFrames --> CongestionControl[Update Congestion Control<br/>Reduce congestion window<br/>NewReno or CUBIC]
    CongestionControl --> End
    
    LostPackets -->|No| End
    
    FrameType -->|PADDING| IgnorePadding[Ignore PADDING<br/>Used for packet size]
    IgnorePadding --> End
    
    FrameType -->|PING| SendPingResponse[Send PING in Response<br/>Path validation]
    SendPingResponse --> End
    
    FrameType -->|CONNECTION_CLOSE| ProcessConnClose[Process CONNECTION_CLOSE<br/>Extract error code]
    ProcessConnClose --> CloseConnection[Close QUIC Connection<br/>Clean up all streams]
    CloseConnection --> End
    
    FrameType -->|PATH_CHALLENGE| ProcessPathChallenge[Process PATH_CHALLENGE<br/>Connection migration validation]
    ProcessPathChallenge --> SendPathResponse[Send PATH_RESPONSE<br/>Echo challenge data]
    SendPathResponse --> UpdateActivePath[Update Active Path<br/>If validation succeeds]
    UpdateActivePath --> End
    
    FrameType -->|PATH_RESPONSE| ValidatePath[Validate PATH_RESPONSE<br/>Match challenge data]
    ValidatePath --> PathValidated[Mark Path Validated<br/>Can migrate connection]
    PathValidated --> End
    
    FrameType -->|NEW_CONNECTION_ID| AddConnectionID[Add Connection ID<br/>Store for potential use]
    AddConnectionID --> End
    
    FrameType -->|RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID| RetireConnectionID[Retire Connection ID<br/>Remove from active set]
    RetireConnectionID --> End
    
    FrameType -->|MAX_DATA| UpdateConnMaxData[Update Connection MAX_DATA<br/>Increase connection flow window]
    UpdateConnMaxData --> End
    
    FrameType -->|MAX_STREAM_DATA| UpdateStreamMaxData[Update Stream MAX_STREAM_DATA<br/>Increase stream flow window]
    UpdateStreamMaxData --> End
    
    FrameType -->|MAX_STREAMS| UpdateMaxStreams[Update MAX_STREAMS<br/>Can open more streams]
    UpdateMaxStreams --> End
    
    FrameType -->|STOP_SENDING| ProcessStopSending[Process STOP_SENDING<br/>Peer doesn't want data]
    ProcessStopSending --> ResetStream[Reset Stream Sending<br/>Send RESET_STREAM]
    ResetStream --> End
    
    FrameType -->|RESET_STREAM| ProcessResetStream[Process RESET_STREAM<br/>Peer cancelled stream]
    ProcessResetStream --> CloseStream
    
    HeaderType -->|0-RTT| ParseZeroRTT[Parse 0-RTT Packet<br/>Early application data]
    ParseZeroRTT --> CheckZeroRTTAllowed{0-RTT Allowed?<br/>Session resumption}
    CheckZeroRTTAllowed -->|No| RejectZeroRTT[Reject 0-RTT Data<br/>Wait for handshake]
    CheckZeroRTTAllowed -->|Yes| Process0RTTData[Process 0-RTT Data<br/>Decrypt with 0-RTT keys]
    Process0RTTData --> ParseFrames
    RejectZeroRTT --> End
    
    HeaderType -->|Handshake| ParseHandshake[Parse Handshake Packet<br/>TLS messages]
    ParseHandshake --> GetConnection
    
    HeaderType -->|Short Header<br/>1-RTT| ParseOneRTT[Parse 1-RTT Packet<br/>Application data]
    ParseOneRTT --> GetConnection
    
    ConnectionEstablished --> ActiveConnection[Active QUIC/HTTP3 Connection]
    ActiveConnection -.-> End
    BlockSending --> End
    ProcessQPACKEnc --> End
    ProcessQPACKDec --> End
```

**QUIC and HTTP/3 Details**:

- **Connection IDs**: QUIC connections identified by connection IDs (CID) instead of 4-tuple (IP, port). Enables connection migration across network changes (WiFi to cellular). Server assigns CIDs; client can request new CIDs via NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames.

- **Encryption Levels**: Four encryption levels: Initial (derived from version and DCID), 0-RTT (from previous session), Handshake (from TLS handshake), Application (from TLS finished). Packets encrypted at appropriate level based on handshake state.

- **Loss Recovery**: QUIC implements its own loss detection and recovery independent of TCP. ACK frames with ACK ranges report received packets. Loss detection triggers after packet threshold (3) or time threshold (PTO). Retransmission occurs in new packets with new packet numbers.

- **Congestion Control**: Pluggable congestion control algorithms. NGINX implements NewReno by default. Congestion window increases on ACKs, decreases on loss. Pacing prevents burst transmission.

- **Flow Control**: Two-level like HTTP/2 but at QUIC layer. MAX_DATA for connection-level, MAX_STREAM_DATA for stream-level. Separate limits for bidirectional and unidirectional streams. MAX_STREAMS limits stream creation.

- **QPACK Compression**: HTTP/3 header compression addressing HTTP/2's HPACK head-of-line blocking. Dynamic table updates sent on separate encoder stream. Decoder sends acknowledgments on decoder stream. Static table same as HTTP/2.

- **HTTP/3 Frames**: Variable-length type/length/value encoding. Frame types: HEADERS (0x01), DATA (0x00), SETTINGS (0x04), GOAWAY (0x07), CANCEL_PUSH (0x03), PUSH_PROMISE (0x05), MAX_PUSH_ID (0x0d).

- **Control Streams**: Each endpoint opens unidirectional control stream (type 0x00) as first frame. SETTINGS frame must be first on control stream. Used for connection-level communications.

### 4.4.4 HTTP Phase Engine Execution

The phase-based request processing engine provides ordered execution of handlers. This flow expands on the content phase from Section 2.7.1.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Phase Engine Entry<br/>ngx_http_core_run_phases]) --> GetPhase[Get Current Phase Handler<br/>r->phase_handler index]
    
    GetPhase --> PhaseType{Phase Type}
    
    PhaseType -->|POST_READ_PHASE| PostRead[Post Read Phase<br/>Early request processing]
    PostRead --> PostReadHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    PostReadHandlers -->|Yes| CallRealIP[F-057: ngx_http_realip_module<br/>Extract real client IP<br/>X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP]
    PostReadHandlers -->|No| NextPhase1
    CallRealIP --> HandlerResult1{Handler Result}
    
    PhaseType -->|SERVER_REWRITE_PHASE| ServerRewrite[Server Rewrite Phase<br/>Server-level URL manipulation]
    ServerRewrite --> ServerRewriteHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    ServerRewriteHandlers -->|Yes| CallServerRewrite[F-070: ngx_http_rewrite_module<br/>Execute rewrite rules<br/>server context]
    ServerRewriteHandlers -->|No| NextPhase2
    CallServerRewrite --> CheckRewrite{Rewrite Occurred?}
    CheckRewrite -->|Yes| ResetPhase[Reset to POST_READ<br/>Re-process with new URI]
    CheckRewrite -->|No| HandlerResult2
    ResetPhase --> GetPhase
    
    PhaseType -->|FIND_CONFIG_PHASE| FindConfig[Find Config Phase<br/>Location matching]
    FindConfig --> MatchLocation[Match URI Against Locations<br/>Exact = > Prefix ^~ ><br/>Regex ~* ~ > Prefix]
    MatchLocation --> LocationFound[Update Request Configuration<br/>Apply location context]
    LocationFound --> NextPhase3[Next Phase<br/>NGX_OK automatic]
    
    PhaseType -->|REWRITE_PHASE| Rewrite[Rewrite Phase<br/>Location-level URL manipulation]
    Rewrite --> RewriteHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    RewriteHandlers -->|Yes| CallLocationRewrite[F-070: ngx_http_rewrite_module<br/>Execute rewrite rules<br/>location context]
    RewriteHandlers -->|No| NextPhase4
    CallLocationRewrite --> CheckLocationRewrite{Rewrite Occurred?}
    CheckLocationRewrite -->|Yes| ResetToFindConfig[Reset to FIND_CONFIG<br/>Find new location]
    CheckLocationRewrite -->|No| HandlerResult3
    ResetToFindConfig --> GetPhase
    
    PhaseType -->|POST_REWRITE_PHASE| PostRewrite[Post Rewrite Phase<br/>After rewrite processing]
    PostRewrite --> CheckRewriteCount{Rewrite Count > 10?}
    CheckRewriteCount -->|Yes| RewriteError[Return 500 Internal Server Error<br/>Rewrite loop detected]
    CheckRewriteCount -->|No| NextPhase5[Next Phase<br/>NGX_OK automatic]
    
    PhaseType -->|PREACCESS_PHASE| PreAccess[Pre-Access Phase<br/>Before access control]
    PreAccess --> PreAccessHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    PreAccessHandlers -->|Yes| CallLimitReq[F-054: ngx_http_limit_req_module<br/>Check rate limits]
    PreAccessHandlers -->|No| NextPhase6
    CallLimitReq --> RateLimit{Rate Limit Exceeded?}
    RateLimit -->|Yes| CheckBurst{Burst Allowed?}
    CheckBurst -->|Yes, Delay| DelayRequest[Delay Request<br/>Queue until token available]
    CheckBurst -->|No| Return503Rate[Return 503 Service Unavailable<br/>Rate limit exceeded]
    RateLimit -->|No| CallLimitConn
    DelayRequest --> CallLimitConn[F-055: ngx_http_limit_conn_module<br/>Check connection limits]
    CallLimitConn --> ConnLimit{Connection Limit Exceeded?}
    ConnLimit -->|Yes| Return503Conn[Return 503 Service Unavailable<br/>Connection limit exceeded]
    ConnLimit -->|No| HandlerResult4
    
    PhaseType -->|ACCESS_PHASE| Access[Access Phase<br/>Access control and authentication]
    Access --> AccessHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    AccessHandlers -->|Yes| CallAccessModule[F-053: ngx_http_access_module<br/>IP-based allow/deny]
    AccessHandlers -->|No| NextPhase7
    CallAccessModule --> IPAllowed{IP Allowed?}
    IPAllowed -->|No| DeniedAccess[Access Denied<br/>Store deny flag]
    IPAllowed -->|Yes| CallAuthBasic
    DeniedAccess --> CallAuthBasic[F-051: ngx_http_auth_basic_module<br/>HTTP Basic Authentication]
    CallAuthBasic --> AuthRequired{Auth Required?}
    AuthRequired -->|Yes| CheckAuthHeader{Authorization Header?}
    CheckAuthHeader -->|No| Return401[Return 401 Unauthorized<br/>WWW-Authenticate header]
    CheckAuthHeader -->|Yes| ValidateCredentials[Validate Credentials<br/>Against password file]
    ValidateCredentials --> CredentialsValid{Valid Credentials?}
    CredentialsValid -->|No| Return401
    CredentialsValid -->|Yes| CallAuthRequest
    AuthRequired -->|No| CallAuthRequest[F-052: ngx_http_auth_request_module<br/>Subrequest authentication]
    CallAuthRequest --> AuthRequestConfigured{auth_request Configured?}
    AuthRequestConfigured -->|Yes| CreateSubrequest[Create Subrequest<br/>To auth_request URI]
    CreateSubrequest --> WaitSubrequest[Wait for Subrequest<br/>NGX_AGAIN]
    WaitSubrequest --> SubrequestResult{Subrequest Status}
    SubrequestResult -->|2xx| AuthSuccess[Authentication Success]
    SubrequestResult -->|Other| Return401Auth[Return 401/403<br/>Authentication failed]
    AuthRequestConfigured -->|No| HandlerResult5
    AuthSuccess --> HandlerResult5
    
    PhaseType -->|POST_ACCESS_PHASE| PostAccess[Post Access Phase<br/>After access control]
    PostAccess --> CheckSatisfy{satisfy Directive}
    CheckSatisfy -->|all| CheckAllSatisfied{All Requirements Met?}
    CheckAllSatisfied -->|No| Return403[Return 403 Forbidden<br/>Access denied]
    CheckAllSatisfied -->|Yes| NextPhase8
    CheckSatisfy -->|any| CheckAnySatisfied{Any Requirement Met?}
    CheckAnySatisfied -->|No| Return403
    CheckAnySatisfied -->|Yes| NextPhase8
    
    PhaseType -->|PRECONTENT_PHASE| PreContent[Pre-Content Phase<br/>Before content generation]
    PreContent --> PreContentHandlers{Handlers Installed?}
    PreContentHandlers -->|Yes| CallTryFiles[F-006: ngx_http_try_files_module<br/>Try multiple file locations]
    PreContentHandlers -->|No| NextPhase9
    CallTryFiles --> TryFilesResult{File Found?}
    TryFilesResult -->|Yes| InternalRedirect[Internal Redirect<br/>Reset to FIND_CONFIG]
    TryFilesResult -->|No| CheckFallback{Fallback URI?}
    CheckFallback -->|Yes| InternalRedirect
    CheckFallback -->|No| HandlerResult6
    InternalRedirect --> GetPhase
    
    PhaseType -->|CONTENT_PHASE| Content[Content Phase<br/>Response generation]
    Content --> ContentHandlers{Content Handler?}
    ContentHandlers -->|Static| StaticContent[F-001: ngx_http_static_module<br/>Serve file from disk]
    ContentHandlers -->|Index| IndexContent[F-004: ngx_http_index_module<br/>Check index files]
    ContentHandlers -->|Autoindex| AutoindexContent[F-003: ngx_http_autoindex_module<br/>Generate directory listing]
    ContentHandlers -->|Proxy| ProxyContent[F-020: ngx_http_proxy_module<br/>See Section 4.5]
    ContentHandlers -->|FastCGI| FastCGIContent[F-021: ngx_http_fastcgi_module<br/>Proxy to FastCGI backend]
    ContentHandlers -->|uWSGI| uWSGIContent[F-022: ngx_http_uwsgi_module<br/>Proxy to uWSGI backend]
    ContentHandlers -->|SCGI| SCGIContent[F-023: ngx_http_scgi_module<br/>Proxy to SCGI backend]
    ContentHandlers -->|gRPC| gRPCContent[F-024: ngx_http_grpc_module<br/>Proxy to gRPC backend]
    ContentHandlers -->|Memcached| MemcachedContent[F-025: ngx_http_memcached_module<br/>Lookup in Memcached]
    ContentHandlers -->|None| NextContentHandler
    
    StaticContent --> ContentResult
    IndexContent --> ContentResult
    AutoindexContent --> ContentResult
    ProxyContent --> ContentResult
    FastCGIContent --> ContentResult
    uWSGIContent --> ContentResult
    SCGIContent --> ContentResult
    gRPCContent --> ContentResult
    MemcachedContent --> ContentResult
    NextContentHandler --> HandlerResult7
    
    PhaseType -->|LOG_PHASE| Log[Log Phase<br/>Request logging]
    Log --> LogHandlers{Log Handlers?}
    LogHandlers -->|Yes| CallLogModule[F-090: ngx_http_log_module<br/>Write access log]
    LogHandlers -->|No| Complete
    CallLogModule --> Complete[Phase Processing Complete]
    
    HandlerResult1 --> CheckResult1{Result}
    HandlerResult2 --> CheckResult1
    HandlerResult3 --> CheckResult1
    HandlerResult4 --> CheckResult1
    HandlerResult5 --> CheckResult1
    HandlerResult6 --> CheckResult1
    HandlerResult7 --> CheckResult1
    ContentResult --> CheckResult1
    
    CheckResult1 -->|NGX_OK| NextPhase1[Advance to Next Phase<br/>Increment phase_handler]
    CheckResult1 -->|NGX_DECLINED| NextHandler[Next Handler in Phase<br/>Try next registered handler]
    CheckResult1 -->|NGX_AGAIN<br/>NGX_DONE| Suspend[Suspend Phase Engine<br/>Resume on event]
    CheckResult1 -->|Status Code| FinalizeWithStatus[Finalize Request<br/>Generate error response]
    CheckResult1 -->|NGX_ERROR| InternalError[Return 500 Internal Server Error]
    
    NextPhase1 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase2 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase3 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase4 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase5 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase6 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase7 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase8 --> GetPhase
    NextPhase9 --> GetPhase
    NextHandler --> GetPhase
    
    Suspend --> End([Processing Suspended])
    FinalizeWithStatus --> End
    InternalError --> End
    Complete --> End
    RewriteError --> End
    Return503Rate --> End
    Return503Conn --> End
    Return401 --> End
    Return401Auth --> End
    Return403 --> End
```

**Phase Engine Details**:

- **Phase Order**: Fixed phase sequence ensures consistent request processing. Phases execute in order; handlers within phases execute until one succeeds or all decline.

- **Phase Types**:
  - **Checker Phases**: All handlers execute (POST_READ, SERVER_REWRITE, REWRITE, PREACCESS, ACCESS, LOG). Handlers return NGX_OK to continue or error to abort.
  - **Finder Phase**: FIND_CONFIG executes automatically without handlers.
  - **Handler Phases**: First successful handler stops phase (CONTENT). Handlers return NGX_DECLINED to try next.

- **Rewrite Processing**: Rewrite phase can reset processing to earlier phases (FIND_CONFIG or POST_READ) after URL modification. Loop detection (10 iterations) prevents infinite rewrites.

- **Access Control**: Supports satisfy any (OR logic) or satisfy all (AND logic) for combining multiple access requirements. Denied access stored as flag checked in POST_ACCESS phase.

- **Content Phase**: Only one content handler executes per request. Handler selection based on location configuration priority. Default handler (ngx_http_static_module) serves files if no explicit handler configured.

- **Subrequests**: auth_request and other modules create subrequests executing their own phase engine. Parent request suspends (NGX_AGAIN) until subrequest completes.

- **Return Values**:
  - **NGX_OK**: Handler succeeded, continue to next phase
  - **NGX_DECLINED**: Handler passed, try next handler in phase
  - **NGX_AGAIN** / **NGX_DONE**: Async operation pending, suspend processing
  - **Status Code** (4xx, 5xx): Generate error response
  - **NGX_ERROR**: Internal error, return 500

## 4.5 Upstream and Load Balancing Flows

### 4.5.1 Upstream Request and Load Balancer Selection

The upstream framework manages connections to backend servers with load balancing and failover.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start([Upstream Request<br/>proxy_pass directive]) --> UpstreamInit[Initialize Upstream<br/>ngx_http_upstream_init<br/>src/http/ngx_http_upstream.c]
    
    UpstreamInit --> AllocUpstream[Allocate Upstream Structure<br/>From request pool]
    
    AllocUpstream --> CheckCache{Cache Enabled?<br/>proxy_cache directive}
    CheckCache -->|Yes| CacheLookup[Cache Lookup<br/>See Section 2.7.3 and 4.6]
    CheckCache -->|No| ResolveUpstream
    
    CacheLookup --> CacheResult{Cache Result}
    CacheResult -->|Hit| ServeFromCache[Serve from Cache<br/>Skip upstream]
    CacheResult -->|Miss/Stale| ResolveUpstream[Resolve Upstream<br/>ngx_http_upstream_init_request]
    
    ResolveUpstream --> CheckResolution{Upstream Requires DNS?<br/>Domain name vs IP}
    CheckResolution -->|Yes| StartResolve[Start DNS Resolution<br/>ngx_resolve_name<br/>Async resolver]
    StartResolve --> ResolvePending[Resolution Pending<br/>NGX_AGAIN]
    ResolvePending --> ResolveResult{Resolution Result}
    ResolveResult -->|Error| UpstreamError[Upstream Resolution Failed<br/>Return 502 Bad Gateway]
    ResolveResult -->|Success| UpdatePeers[Update Upstream Peers<br/>IP addresses from DNS]
    UpdatePeers --> SelectPeer
    
    CheckResolution -->|No| SelectPeer[Select Upstream Peer<br/>ngx_http_upstream_get_peer]
    
    SelectPeer --> LoadBalancer{Load Balancing Algorithm}
    
    LoadBalancer -->|Round Robin<br/>F-030| RoundRobin[ngx_http_upstream_get_round_robin_peer<br/>Smooth weighted selection]
    LoadBalancer -->|Least Conn<br/>F-031| LeastConn[ngx_http_upstream_get_least_conn_peer<br/>Minimum active connections]
    LoadBalancer -->|IP Hash<br/>F-032| IPHash[ngx_http_upstream_get_ip_hash_peer<br/>Hash client IP]
    LoadBalancer -->|Hash<br/>F-033| GenericHash[ngx_http_upstream_get_hash_peer<br/>Hash custom key]
    LoadBalancer -->|Random<br/>F-034| Random[ngx_http_upstream_get_random_peer<br/>Random selection, optional two-choice]
    
    RoundRobin --> ComputeWeights[Compute Current Weights<br/>current_weight += effective_weight<br/>Select max current_weight<br/>Subtract total_weight from selected]
    ComputeWeights --> CheckAvailable
    
    LeastConn --> FindMinConn[Find Peer with Min Connections<br/>Weighted by server weight]
    FindMinConn --> CheckAvailable
    
    IPHash --> ComputeIPHash[Hash Client IP<br/>CRC32 of first 3 octets IPv4<br/>or full IPv6 address]
    ComputeIPHash --> MapToServer[Map Hash to Server Index<br/>Modulo number of servers]
    MapToServer --> CheckAvailable
    
    GenericHash --> ComputeKeyHash[Hash Configured Key<br/>Variables: $uri, $arg_*, etc.<br/>CRC32 or MurmurHash2]
    ComputeKeyHash --> ConsistentHash{Consistent Hashing?}
    ConsistentHash -->|Yes| ConsistentMap[Map to Consistent Hash Ring<br/>Minimal disruption on server changes]
    ConsistentHash -->|No| SimpleMap[Simple Modulo Mapping]
    ConsistentMap --> CheckAvailable
    SimpleMap --> CheckAvailable
    
    Random --> GenerateRandom[Generate Random Number]
    GenerateRandom --> TwoChoice{Two-Choice Enabled?}
    TwoChoice -->|Yes| SelectTwo[Select Two Random Servers<br/>Choose one with fewer connections]
    TwoChoice -->|No| SelectRandom[Select Single Random Server<br/>Weighted by server weight]
    SelectTwo --> CheckAvailable
    SelectRandom --> CheckAvailable[Check Server Available]
    
    CheckAvailable --> ServerStatus{Server Status}
    ServerStatus -->|Down| CheckBackup{Backup Servers Available?}
    CheckBackup -->|Yes| SelectBackup[Select from Backup Servers<br/>Apply same algorithm]
    CheckBackup -->|No| AllFailed[All Servers Failed<br/>Return 502 Bad Gateway]
    SelectBackup --> CreateConnection
    
    ServerStatus -->|Failed Recently| CheckMaxFails{Attempts < max_fails?}
    CheckMaxFails -->|No| CheckFailTimeout{Within fail_timeout?}
    CheckFailTimeout -->|Yes| ServerStatus
    CheckFailTimeout -->|No| ResetFails[Reset Fail Count<br/>Try server again]
    ResetFails --> CreateConnection
    CheckMaxFails -->|Yes| TryPeer[Mark Peer for Try]
    
    ServerStatus -->|Available| TryPeer
    TryPeer --> CreateConnection[Create Upstream Connection<br/>ngx_http_upstream_connect]
    
    CreateConnection --> CheckKeepalive{Keepalive Pool Available?<br/>upstream keepalive}
    CheckKeepalive -->|Yes| GetKeepalive[Get Connection from Pool<br/>Reuse existing connection]
    CheckKeepalive -->|No| OpenSocket[Open TCP Socket<br/>socket with O_NONBLOCK]
    
    GetKeepalive --> ValidateKeepalive{Connection Valid?}
    ValidateKeepalive -->|No| CloseStale[Close Stale Connection]
    CloseStale --> OpenSocket
    ValidateKeepalive -->|Yes| ReuseConnection[Reuse Keepalive Connection]
    
    OpenSocket --> SetSocketOptions[Set Socket Options<br/>TCP_NODELAY<br/>Socket buffers]
    
    SetSocketOptions --> BindSource{Source Address Configured?<br/>proxy_bind}
    BindSource -->|Yes| BindSocket[Bind to Source Address<br/>bind system call]
    BindSource -->|No| ConnectSocket
    BindSocket --> ConnectSocket[Connect to Upstream<br/>connect non-blocking]
    
    ConnectSocket --> ConnectResult{Connect Result}
    ConnectResult -->|EINPROGRESS| AddConnectTimer[Add Connect Timeout<br/>proxy_connect_timeout]
    ConnectResult -->|Error| ConnectError[Connection Error<br/>Mark server failed]
    ConnectResult -->|Success| Connected
    
    AddConnectTimer --> WaitConnect[Wait for Connection<br/>Write event ready]
    WaitConnect --> CheckConnectError{Socket Error?<br/>getsockopt SO_ERROR}
    CheckConnectError -->|Yes| ConnectError
    CheckConnectError -->|No| Connected[Connection Established]
    
    ConnectError --> IncrementFails[Increment Fail Count<br/>Check max_fails threshold]
    IncrementFails --> CheckNext{Next Peer Available?<br/>proxy_next_upstream}
    CheckNext -->|Yes| FreePeer[Free Current Peer]
    FreePeer --> SelectPeer
    CheckNext -->|No| AllFailed
    
    Connected --> SetHandlers[Set Event Handlers<br/>Write: ngx_http_upstream_send_request_handler<br/>Read: ngx_http_upstream_process_header]
    
    SetHandlers --> SendRequest[Send Request to Upstream<br/>See Section 4.5.2]
    
    ReuseConnection --> SetHandlers
    
    ServeFromCache --> End([Request Complete])
    AllFailed --> End
    UpstreamError --> End
    SendRequest -.-> End
```

**Load Balancing Algorithm Details**:

- **Round Robin (F-030)**: Smooth weighted algorithm avoids burst behavior. Each server has current_weight starting at 0. Each selection: `current_weight += effective_weight`, select server with max current_weight, subtract total_weight from selected server's current_weight. Achieves proportional distribution over time.

- **Least Connections (F-031)**: Tracks active connections per server in shared memory (upstream zone). Selects server with minimum connections weighted by configured weight. Optimal for variable request processing times.

- **IP Hash (F-032)**: Computes CRC32 hash of client IP address (first 3 octets for IPv4, full address for IPv6). Maps hash to server index via modulo. Provides session affinity without cookies. Fails over to next server if primary unavailable.

- **Generic Hash (F-033)**: Hashes arbitrary key (URI, cookie, header, etc.) using CRC32 or MurmurHash2. Supports consistent hashing reducing redistribution when servers added/removed. Configurable via `hash $variable [consistent];`
